## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `trello-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a Power-Up in the admin portal

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your Trello account. -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to the [Trello Power-Ups admin portal](https://trello.com/power-ups/admin). -->
3. Select **New** to create a new Power-Up.
4. Fill in the required fields (name, workspace, and a placeholder iframe connector URL) and select **Create**.
5. <!-- manual: Fill in the required fields (name, workspace, and a placeholder iframe connector URL) and select Create. -->

## Step 3: Generate an API key

1. After creation, select the Power-Up name to open its settings.
2. Select **API Key**.
3. Select **Generate a new API Key** and copy the displayed **API Key**.

## Step 4: Generate an API token

1. On the same API Key page, select **Token** link next to **your API key**.
2. Review the permissions requested and select **Allow**.
3. <!-- manual: Review the permissions requested -->
4. <!-- manual: Copy the generated Token. -->
